+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+use std::path::Path;
+use std::process::Command;
+
+use serde_json::Value;
+
+#[test]
+fn reviewgraphen_generated_regression() {
+    let root = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
+        .parent()
+        .and_then(Path::parent)
+        .expect("repository root")
+        .to_path_buf();
+    let requirements = root.join("rust/target").join(format!(
+        "reviewgraphen-calibration-08-requirements-{}.txt",
+        std::process::id()
+    ));
+    std::fs::create_dir_all(requirements.parent().expect("requirements parent"))
+        .expect("create target directory");
+    let missing = "REQ-REVIEWGRAPHEN-MISSING";
+    std::fs::write(&requirements, format!("{missing}\n{missing}\n"))
+        .expect("write requirement registry");
+
+    let output = Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_fslc"))
+        .args([
+            "check",
+            "specs/cart_v1.fsl",
+            "--strict-tags",
+            "--requirements",
+            requirements.to_str().expect("UTF-8 requirements path"),
+        ])
+        .current_dir(&root)
+        .output()
+        .expect("run fslc check");
+    std::fs::remove_file(&requirements).expect("remove requirement registry");
+
+    assert!(
+        output.status.success(),
+        "{}",
+        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
+    );
+    let value: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&output.stdout).expect("JSON output");
+    let warnings = value["warnings"].as_array().expect("warnings");
+    let matching = warnings
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|warning| {
+            warning["kind"] == "unreferenced_requirement" && warning["name"] == missing
+        })
+        .count();
+    assert_eq!(
+        matching, 1,
+        "a repeated requirement ID must produce one diagnostic: {warnings:?}"
+    );
+}
